questions.question: Do you encrypt data at rest and in transit?
questions.answer: Yes. All production data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. Data in transit is encrypted via TLS 1.2+ across all customer-facing endpoints.

questions.question: Describe your incident response process, including detection and notification timelines.
questions.answer: We maintain a documented incident response plan (IR Playbook v4) with 24/7 on-call coverage and a 15-minute acknowledgment SLA for P1 incidents. Customers are notified within 72 hours of a confirmed breach affecting their data, per our DPA.
questions.source_doc: IR Playbook v4 / Data Processing Agreement

questions.question: Do you have a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty program?
questions.answer: Yes. We operate a responsible disclosure program via security@[company].com, with triage within one business day and a defined severity-based remediation timeline.

questions.question: List all sub-processors that handle customer data, including their location.
questions.answer: Current sub-processors: AWS (us-east-1, primary hosting), Stripe (payment processing), Resend (transactional email). Full and up-to-date list maintained at our public trust page.

questions.question: Do you perform regular penetration testing or third-party security audits?
questions.answer: We engage a third-party firm for annual penetration testing, with the most recent test completed in Q1 2025. A summary report is available under NDA.

questions.question: How do you handle data deletion requests, and within what timeframe?
questions.answer: Customer data is deleted within 30 days of a verified deletion request, in accordance with our DPA and applicable data protection regulations. Backups are purged on a rolling 90-day cycle.

questions.question: Do you maintain a formal employee security awareness training program?
questions.answer: All employees complete security awareness training during onboarding and annually thereafter, covering phishing, data handling, and incident reporting.

questions.question: What is your policy on multi-factor authentication for internal systems and customer accounts?
questions.answer: MFA is enforced for all internal systems with access to production data. Customer-facing MFA is available and recommended but not currently enforced by default — this is on our roadmap for Q3 2025.
